target.description: A conversation a reply cannot address: a top-level post into a dm or a channel (a team notice is a channel post, not a thread reply wearing a costume - B4).
target.title: PostConversationTarget

artifacts.description: Outbound media posted alongside the notice (same law as the reply command).

oneOf.description: Fire-and-forget: the surface posts this exact text AS THE PRESSER where it can author as them (channel webhooks). Where it cannot (a bot cannot speak as a user), the surface MUST fall back to the prefill law.

The honest bot law: the button opens the human's own input box with this text (Telegram reply keyboard, Slack button-block copy); the human sends it, so the resulting message carries the presser's proven authorship on the existing authority plane (C7).

value.description: Exact text to submit as the presser's message.

prefill.description: Exact text offered to the presser to send as their own message (Telegram reply keyboard, Slack button copy): the human sends it, so the message carries the presser's proven authorship on the existing authority plane (C7).

buttons.description: Interactive affordances (C7). Every button carries the EXACT command text a decision rides; a surface without buttons renders nothing extra - the text always stands alone.
